subject.title: feat: let plugin tools yield turns

question: Should `yieldToolResult(...)` together with `canYield: true` and `executionMode: "sequential"` become a supported permanent Plugin SDK contract for plugin-owned external interactions?
rationale: The implementation is bounded and tested, but accepting a new public Plugin SDK result-control primitive determines the long-term external API and compatibility obligation.

options.title: Adopt the opt-in contract
options.body: Approve the documented yield result, capability declaration, and sequential scheduling requirement as the supported plugin-to-runtime handoff surface.

options.title: Narrow or defer the API
options.body: Keep the underlying feature request open and request a different or narrower SDK boundary before exposing this permanent public contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt the opt-in contract
recommendation.body: Approve the documented yield result, capability declaration, and sequential scheduling requirement as the supported plugin-to-runtime handoff surface.
